artifacts.purpose: Declare host context, target profile, execution surface, command digest source, and bridge proof before handoff.
Record PASS/BLOCKED classification, reason codes, command SHA-256, and next action without echoing raw command text.
Human-readable summary of host/surface identity, blockers, validation, proof ceiling, and next action.

naming: Use one run directory per handoff attempt; never overwrite evidence from a different device or execution surface.
forbiddenContent: raw command text when it may contain secrets
proofCeiling: Artifacts prove declared routing state and deterministic classification only; they do not prove the target shell, runtime, or command actually executed unless separate runtime evidence says so.
